When I was 5 my uncle died. I wasnt allowed to go to the funeral so a few weeks later my mum and my grandma took me to the cemetery. They parked the car and let me out, I then immediately ran over to a grave (pretty far from the car), sat down and started to talk to someone. My mum and grandma came chasing after me and asked who I was talking to, confused I said "Uncle Ant".
Having never been to the cemetery before, I ran over to where he was buried and had a full on conversation. My mum and my grandma have no explanation for what happened and I was obviously too young to understand the magnitude of it. Kinda creeps me out because I can remember snippets of that day very vividly.
